name: Expense Income Tracker
description: Records income and expense transactions as a fieldable content entity with recurring entries, bulk import (CSV/JSON/XML/XLSX), Highcharts reports, and a REST API.

suggests.drupal/devel: Enables the DevelGenerate plugin to bulk-create sample transactions.

project_description: Expense Income Tracker adds a self-contained personal/business finance layer to a Drupal 10 or 11 site. Income and expense records are stored as a dedicated fieldable content entity (et_transaction) with its own tables, Field UI base route, access-control handler, list builder, view builder and Views data, so records gain multilingual support, URL aliases (Pathauto), comment threads, published/unpublished status and Views integration. Transactions can be one-off or grouped under a parent "category" transaction; a cron-driven repeat system auto-generates copies on daily/weekly/monthly/yearly and custom schedules. Data can be entered through a two-column admin form, bulk-imported from CSV, JSON, XML or XLSX via a Batch-API upload form (XLSX parsed by the bundled ExcelReaderService, no extra PHP libraries), or seeded from a bundled 60-row demo dataset. Interactive Highcharts charts and tabular statements summarise income vs expense by day, week, month, quarter or year, with currency formatting configurable in module settings. A six-endpoint REST API (single-record CRUD, a filterable/paginated collection, and a bulk-import resource) plus normalize/create/update/query/import alter hooks let decoupled frontends and third-party systems read and write transactions.
